title: Large-list scroll
scenario: A Grid (five single-line text columns) over a synthetic 100,000-row model (variant rows-1m: 1,000,000 rows), revealed at its middle row (variants default and rows-1m at 1280x720, fhd at 1920x1080, uhd-192dpi at 3840x2160 and 192 DPI), beside a Tree over a synthetic, fully expanded 10,000-row model; absolute layout, reduced motion. A hover phase moves the pointer between two Grid rows (20 frames); then each list is scrolled for 10 s of the frozen fixture clock at 120 Hz, one wheel notch down per frame (1,200 frames each); a last phase focuses the Tree and presses 24 navigation keys, one per frame. The models compute every row from its index and store none. G6 (missed frames) is a hardware timing verdict: not measured here; the receipt records the work of every scroll step and memory per row count.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm

phases.name: hover
phases.description: the pointer moves between two Grid rows 40 DIP apart: one hover change per frame

phases.name: grid
phases.description: the clock advances 8 or 9 ms (120 Hz) and one wheel notch down scrolls the Grid

phases.name: tree
phases.description: the clock advances 8 or 9 ms (120 Hz) and one wheel notch down scrolls the Tree

phases.name: tree-keys
phases.description: the Tree takes focus on its first visible row, then one key per frame: Down, Up, Page Down, Page Up, End and Home (W2.6)
